facts.claim: NGV International is at 180 St Kilda Road, Melbourne
Its collection spans art from Europe, Asia, America and Oceania
General entry is free; some special exhibitions are ticketed

name: Royal Botanic Gardens Victoria

facts.claim: Melbourne Gardens covers 38 hectares and was founded in 1846 on the south side of the Yarra
The gardens slope to the river with lakes, lawns and almost 50,000 plants of 8,500 taxa
Entry is free; guided walks and the Explorer minibus are bookable

access_note: Gardens close at night, but spot carries no hours; free entry per Wikipedia, not stated on loaded official pages

name: Melbourne Cricket Ground

facts.claim: MCG tours run 75 minutes behind the scenes, departing from Gate 3
The Australian Sports Museum is housed at the ground
Tours only run on select event days; check availability

name: Royal Exhibition Building

facts.claim: UNESCO World Heritage site, built for the 1880 International Exhibition in Carlton Gardens
The first Parliament of Australia opened here on 9 May 1901
The Dome Promenade reopened to public tours in October 2022; adult tour $29

access_note: Interior mainly accessible on bookable tours or event days

name: Melbourne Museum

facts.claim: Natural and cultural history museum in Carlton Gardens, opened 2000
Adult general admission is $15; children under 16 and concession holders free
Includes the Bunjilaka Aboriginal Cultural Centre and the IMAX cinema is on site

name: Luna Park Melbourne

facts.claim: Seaside amusement park in St Kilda opened in 1912, with the Mr Moon face entrance
The 1912 Scenic Railway is the oldest continuously operating roller coaster in the world
Park entry is $30 with one ride; unlimited rides $47
